title: Reproduce the origin of enantioselectivity in a CBSCA-catalyzed isochroman synthesis
difficulty_reasons: The qualitative route is known, but four stereochemical pathway families, catalyst/binding conformers and transition-state conformers must be generated and discriminated.
A defensible answer requires per-candidate transition-state connectivity, common-reference free energies and search-coverage justification.

paper.title: Catalytic Enantioselective Synthesis of 1,1-Disubstituted Isochromans
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: Self-contained XYZ coordinates plus explicit component identity, connectivity, charge, multiplicity, stereochemistry, product and model boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable investigation, validation, free-energy comparison, conclusion or bounded-failure record.
